summary: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to correct a typographical error in the sub-numbering of Note 2 to the Consolidated Financial Statements in its previously filed annual report on Form 20-F for FY2024. The correction changes first-level subparagraph numbering from 1-10 to A-J, with no amendments to financial statements or other disclosures. This is a routine administrative correction, not a special situation event. No deal terms, shareholder actions, or strategic changes are involved.
